newsitem.title: UK: NatWest up as Hoare Govett rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: NatWest up as Hoare Govett rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc led bank stocks higher on Tuesday as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett issued a "buy" rating on the stock, traders said.
NatWest shares were up 10p at 689 by 0820 GMT in active trade of over 1 million shares -- near the year's high of 696p set August 19.
In a firm bank sector, Barclays Plc was up 6p at 944, Lloyds TSB Group Plc was up 4p at 381-1/2 and Royal Bank of Scotland was up 9-1/2p at 495.
A report in the Daily Mail helped revive bid speculation in the industry, saying Royal Bank could be a target for HSBC Holdings Plc, down 4-1/2p at 11.95 stg.

Analysts at Hoare Govett rated NatWest a "buy" because domestic cost-cutting measures, together with last month's debt securitisation, would bring the company's return on assets closer to that of rival Barclays.
They argued that as NatWest began to operate at a similar level of profitability to Barclays, the valuation difference between the two stocks would narrow in NatWest's favour.
